info.title: Mini-Grid Financial Model Studio API
info.description: Deterministic project-finance engine for mini-grid portfolios. Results are not a certification by AfDB, the World Bank or CrossBoundary, nor legal or investment advice.

post.description: Create an organisation and its first administrator (disabled unless MGS_ALLOW_SIGNUP=true).

New users set their own password here. Existing users must call this
endpoint while signed in as the invited account (bearer token).

schema.title: Response Members Api V1 Orgs  Org Id  Members Get

post.description:
Create a single-use invitation. No account is created and no password is
set by the admin; existing accounts are never attached without their consent.

schema.title: Response Invitations Api V1 Orgs  Org Id  Invitations Get

delete.description:
Remove a member; their project memberships in this organisation go too and
all their sessions are revoked.

schema.title: Response Audit Log Api V1 Orgs  Org Id  Audit Get
Response List Projects Api V1 Projects Get
Response List Versions Api V1 Projects  Project Id  Versions Get

post.description:
Read the assumptions of a workbook in the CrossBoundary format. The file
is parsed as data only: formulas are not evaluated and macros never run.
(Synchronous handler: FastAPI runs it in a worker thread, not on the event loop.)

schema.title: Response List Runs Api V1 Versions  Version Id  Runs Get

get.description: Annual series with their unit and workbook source row, one column per year.

Studio workbook: engine values with their workbook source, and live Excel formulas that recompute
the accounting identities, DSCR, project IRR (XIRR) and NPV (XNPV) next to a gap column.
PDF report: status, alerts, indicators with sources, charts, annual summary, checks, assumptions, lots.

post.description:
Fill YOUR copy of the CrossBoundary workbook with this run's assumptions and pasted values. The template
is not stored; only input cells are rewritten, formulas, charts and macros are kept; Excel recalculates on
opening. Variant runs are refused: the workbook does not implement the engine options.
Indicators, key series and differing assumptions of 2 to 4 runs (the first is the base).

get.description:
FR/EN labels of groups, fields, indicators, series, checks and units, plus the rules that give the
French form of engine messages (Python regex syntax; replacement groups written \1).
Editable assumptions with their group, FR/EN labels, unit, workbook cell and note.
